name: AlphaCode
one_liner: Samples millions of candidate programs per competitive programming problem, filters by example tests, and clusters by synthetic input behavior.

loop.proposes: An encoder-decoder transformer generates a large pool of candidate C++ and Python solutions from the problem description.
loop.judged_by: A sandboxed execution engine filters out candidates that fail public example tests (>99% pruned) and runs the survivors on generated test inputs to cluster equivalent behaviors.
loop.steers: Behavioral clustering selects one representative program from each of the largest equivalence classes for final submission.

headline_result: Placed in the top 54.3% of human participants across 10 recent Codeforces competitions, the first AI system to reach competitive human rank.
caveat: Relies on sampling hundreds of thousands of programs per problem; passing public example tests does not prove correctness on hidden edge cases.
beyond_harness_note: Large-scale execution filtering and behavioral equivalence clustering select among a massive population of candidate programs.
algorithmic_authority: Sandboxed test execution and input-output equivalence clustering

verification.notes: Checked against Li et al., Science 378(6624), 2022.
